senses.definition: The first element of a full name, particularly when it could also be surname in East Asian and other cultural traditions.
senses.example: In a structure typical for East Asia cultures, first names are usually used as family names. It usually identifies that person is a one of the members of a group (typically a family or clan) who have a common family name.

senses.definition: Synonym of given name, particularly when it forms the first element of a full name.
senses.example: Imagine a country where children do nothing but play until they start compulsory schooling at age seven. Then, without exception, they attend comprehensives until the age of 16.[…]Children address teachers by their first names. Even 15-year-olds do no more than 30 minutes' homework a night.
synonyms: particularly when it forms the first element of a full name
